reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder my usual brand when it runs out. I don't need it to go, so a sachet format doesn't solve anything for me.
objection: I already have a magnesium I take every night at home. Paying $25 to $30 a month to switch for a travel-style sachet that I don't need doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price per day than what I pay now, or a real reason my current magnesium is worse, like a lab report showing it has less magnesium than the label says.
